- **Task note**: marked complete.
- **PR state**: no conflicts, branch up to date, no unresolved threads, 6/7 checks green with only "Type Check & Lint" still running (no failures).

Everything is ready — say the word and I'll merge [cloudlands-fe#1122](https://github.com/intent-hq/cloudlands-fe/pull/1122) (squash, `--auto` so it lands once the last check passes).
